import sys
from collections import deque

sys.setrecursionlimit(200000)
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n, m = data[0], data[1]
g = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]
pos = 2
for _ in range(m):
    u, v = data[pos], data[pos + 1]
    pos += 2
    g[u].append(v)

for u in range(1, n + 1):
    g[u].sort()

dfs_vis = [False] * (n + 1)
dfs_order = []

def dfs(u):
    dfs_vis[u] = True
    dfs_order.append(str(u))
    for v in g[u]:
        if not dfs_vis[v]:
            dfs(v)

dfs(1)

bfs_vis = [False] * (n + 1)
bfs_vis[1] = True
bfs_order = []
q = deque([1])
while q:
    u = q.popleft()
    bfs_order.append(str(u))
    for v in g[u]:
        if not bfs_vis[v]:
            bfs_vis[v] = True
            q.append(v)

print(' '.join(dfs_order))
print(' '.join(bfs_order))
